title: Porch Light
authorship: Original composition authored for this project; no source melody or MIDI sequence copied
brief: An original eight-bar miniature for the before-and-after example: one note changes between two renders.

sections.intent: A phrase that turns to the dominant
The answer: a held note in bar 5, which the example revises, and a close on the tonic

decisions: Every part plays on the default MS Basic bank, so the quick start setup renders the example.
The flute is the lead and sends to the plate; its held note in bar 5 rings into bar 6, so a change to that note reaches the plate return past the note itself.
